title: Inside Ukraine’s robot army fighting Russia
source_used: The Kyiv Independent video page (only the page description of the video could be read; there is no article text)
key_facts: The Kyiv Independent published a video explainer on 10 Oct 2026, 'Inside Ukraine's robot army fighting Russia', by Francis Farrell, Olena Zashko and Dominika Ozynska.
Farrell joins the Alter Ego Battalion of Ukraine's 93rd Mechanized Brigade.
The video shows how Ukrainian soldiers are developing and deploying unmanned ground vehicles in the war against Russia.
quote_evidence: The Kyiv Independent’s Francis Farrell joins the Alter Ego Battalion of Ukraine’s 93rd Mechanized Brigade to see how Ukrainian soldiers are developing and deploying unmanned ground vehicles in the war against Russia.
why_it_matters_hint: Only the video's description is available: a frontline Ukrainian unit is building and using ground robots.
notes: The pre-fetched page text (242 characters) was an unrelated teaser about medics; the real page, read with curl, is a video page whose only text is the one-sentence description above. Google News RSS searches for the story found no second outlet carrying this video report; a Business Insider piece of 9 Oct 2026 on Ukraine's all-robotic assaults is a different story and was not used.
